name: simplehealth-fullstack
description: SimpleHealth - full stack app (Express/MongoDB backend + vanilla JS frontend)

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend/backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend/backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend/backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
